article.story: STOCKTON, Calif. -- — Damarion Vann-Kelly scored 16 points and sealed the victory with a jump shot with 18 seconds remaining as Pacific took down Bradley 63-62 on Saturday. Vann-Kelly shot 6 for 10, including 3 for 7 from beyond the arc for the Tigers (5-1). CJ Jones scored 14 points and added five assists. Gavin Ripp had eight points and finished 4 of 7 from the floor. Ben Thornbrue led the way for the Braves (3-4) with 12 points and two steals. Bradley also got 10 points from Trevon Payton and Kyle Grill. Jones scored 10 points in the first half for Pacific, which led 40-33 at halftime. Vann-Kelly scored a team-high seven points for Pacific in the second half, including the game-winner. Up next: Pacific’s next game is Wednesday against Jacksonville State. Bradley hosts Chicago State on Saturday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
